preconditions.description: The picture dimensions A and B are positive integers not exceeding 20.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line) == B for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: The picture consists of exactly A lines, each containing exactly B uppercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The first line of stdout is a positive integer representing the number of good puzzles (pairs (X, Y) where X divides A, Y divides B, and all pieces are unique up to rotation).

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.splitlines()) == 2 and all(part.isdigit() for part in stdout.splitlines()[1].split())
postconditions.description: The second line of stdout contains two integers X and Y representing the minimal piece size (X × Y) among all good puzzles, ordered by area (XY) and then by X.

postconditions.expression: all(X * Y <= A * B for X, Y in [(int(x), int(y)) for x, y in [line.split() for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]]])
postconditions.description: The minimal piece size (X, Y) satisfies X divides A and Y divides B, and no smaller valid (X', Y') exists.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= X <= A and 1 <= Y <= B for X, Y in [(int(x), int(y)) for x, y in [line.split() for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]]])
postconditions.description: The minimal piece size (X, Y) is within valid bounds (1 ≤ X ≤ A, 1 ≤ Y ≤ B).
